name: Media Gallery
description: The Media Gallery module allows you to create and manage galleries of media items on your Drupal site.
project_description:
A simple gallery of media.

 Features 
 
 Add media from URL, upload or existing files (core media) 
 Multi-file upload (core media) 
 Drag and drop re-ordering (core media) 
 PhotoSwipe support (by default) 
 ColorBox support (optional) 
 Optional pagination 
 Optional reverse order 
 Insert gallery into CKEditor 
 Latest Gallery Items block with multiple layout options 
 Layout Builder compatibility for Media Gallery 
 Path Auto module compatibility 
 
 Requirements 
 
 Media (core) 
 Media Library (core) 
 Photoswipe 
 
 Information about content migration 
 How to migrate galleries from 7.x-1.x to 2.x 

 How to migrate galleries from 2.0.x to 2.1.x
